prompt: Convert $3$ gallons to quarts. ($1$ gal $= 4$ qt)
hint: Each gallon can be poured into a fixed number of quart containers. How many quarts come from one gallon?

hints.text: Each gallon can be poured into a fixed number of quart containers. How many quarts come from one gallon?
One gallon fills $4$ quarts, so $3$ gallons fill $3$ times as many: multiply $3 \times 4$.
$3 \times 4 = 12$, so an amount of $3$ gallons is $12$ quarts.

explanation: Start from the given fact that $1$ gallon equals $4$ quarts.
Quarts are the smaller unit, so the count goes up and you multiply the gallons by $4$.
Three groups of four quarts make $3 \times 4 = 12$ quarts.
Three gallons are the same amount as $12$ quarts.
